eps.d: Scooby and his friends hunt a gang of safecrackers using a haunted construction site as a vantage point.

eps.t: The Fiesta Host is an Aztec Ghost
eps.d: The gang searches for a missing treasure while on their Mexican vacation.

eps.t: The Gruesome Game of the Gator Ghoul
eps.d: The gang visits Ma and Pa Skillet on a down-south showboat restaurant and run into the Gator Ghoul, an alligator-headed monster.
Scooby and the gang investigate when an electric ghost sabotages the local power plant at a ski resort.
In Sleepy Hollow, the gang investigates the legendary Headless Horseman when he shows up at a Halloween costume party at Crane Manor.
Jewel thieves hide out at a reconstructed English castle and use the ghosts of Merlin and the Black Knight as a cover.
A trip to Niagara Falls lands the gang in the middle of an adventure involving a mysterious sanitarium and the ghost of a mad doctor.
Scooby sees a faceless zombie steal the "Golden Galleon" from a coin shop, leading the gang to the Dilly Dally Dolly Company.

eps.t: Mamba Wamba and the Voodoo Hoodoo
eps.d: At a plantation, the gang investigates the curse that seems to linger over a rock group.

eps.t: A Frightened Hound Meets Demons Underground
eps.d: The gang goes to Seattle to investigate demons in an underground city and embarks on a wild ride on underground streetcars.
The gang encounters a flying bull and a gang of cattle rustlers while visiting Daphne's uncle at a ranch.

eps.t: There's a Demon Shark in the Foggy Dark
eps.d: The gang goes on a water-skiing outing to the Aqua Land marine park and becomes involved in the mystery of the Shark Demon, a shark/human monster.
While on a cruise on Professor Poisson's boat, the "Sea Prowler," the gang encounters a nautical ghost and an undersea treasure-trove.

eps.t: The Ghost That Sacked the Quarterback
eps.d: A star athlete vanishes off the field during a game, leading the gang on a journey into underground tunnels and trapdoors.

eps.t: The Ghost of the Bad Humor Man
eps.d: The Mystery Machine skids and runs into the Happy Humor Ice Cream factory, leading the gang into a mystery involving chocolate, vanilla and strawberry-flavored gorillas and some missing armored trucks.
On a trip to Washington D.C., the gang is accidentally locked into the Splitsonian Institute, where they track a set of mysterious footprints.

eps.t: The Curse of the Viking Lake
eps.d: The gang go for some fishing, with Velma's Uncle John, only to find him missing -- and long dead Vikings and their ship haunting the area!
The gang visits a friend on a forbidding island reputed to be the home of vampires.
During a hang-gliding competition, the gang investigates ghostly dinosaurs and cave-men in a Western canyon.
The filming of Scooby-Dee's new film is disrupted when a phantom appears on the set.

eps.t: The Spooky Case of the Grand Prix Race
eps.d: Shag and Scooby play decoy to uncover the truth behind a phantom racer and some disappearing racecars.
The gang spends a stormy night at Hatfield's cabin, only to see a witch transform their host into a frog. Searching for a solution, they encounter a zombie and a witch's cave.
The gang wins a South Seas cruise and stumbles upon a mystery involving a time machine and a futuristic monster.

eps.t: The Creepy Heap from the Deep
eps.d: A huge sea monster disrupts the kids' beach party, but when they take refuge in an old house they run into a ghostly sea captain whose spirit has been stolen by the monster.

When Velma's uncle fails to show up for a meeting, the gang heads to his cabin where they learn about the willawaw, an owl-like monster that according to legend will carry its victim off when an owl calls the person's name.

eps.t: A Creepy Tangle in the Bermuda Triangle
eps.d: While vacationing on a sailboat, the kids aid Naval Intelligence to halt the mysterious disappearances of airplanes.

eps.t: A Scary Night with a Snow Beast Fright
eps.d: Professor Krueger summons the kids to the North Pole, where they confront a giant Snow Beast.
A witch burned at the stake in 1779 suddenly appears in Salem, Massachusetts.
After an archaeologist discovers an ancient Turkish city, his workers are terrified by the "Tar Monster," a legendary creature that protects the city.

eps.t: A Highland Fling with a Monstrous Thing
eps.d: Velma's friend Aggie summons the gang to Scotland to solve the case of the Loch Ness Monster, which is terrorizing guests at her hotel.

eps.t: The Creepy Case of Old Iron Face
eps.d: Old Iron Face, a legendary character who haunts the area around an island prison, terrorizes the gang.
When their plane crashes en route to Rio, the kids confront the legendary Jaguaro--a creature half sabre-tooth tiger, half ape.

eps.t: Make a Beeline Away from That Feline
eps.d: After Daphne's Aunt Olivia receives a medallion of the Cat Creature, she has strange dreams about becoming the thieving feline.

eps.t: The Creepy Creature of Vulture's Claw
eps.d: While visiting a botanical garden, the kids confront a seven-foot-tall preying mantis.
The ghostly Disc Demon attempts to steal the last tune written by a missing songwriter.
The kids travel to China to visit a friend plagued by an ancient legend.
In Italy, the kids investigate the case of the Ghostly Gondolier.

eps.t: Don't Go Near the Fortress of Fear
eps.d: In Puerto Rico, the gang witnesses a robbery at a local museum and confronts a legendary ghost.
An ancient druid plagues a famous teenage tennis player.

eps.t: The Beast is Awake in Bottomless Lake
eps.d: During a vacation to a Canadian fishing village, the kids encounter a terrifying lake monster.
